sections.title: Bonds to 10
facts: Turn them round and they still make $10$: $9 + 1$, $8 + 2$, $7 + 3$, $6 + 4$.
Each pair gives a take-away fact too: $3 + 7 = 10$, so $10 - 3 = 7$ and $10 - 7 = 3$.

sections.title: Bonds to 20
facts: Add a ten to a bond to $10$: $4 + 6 = 10$, so $14 + 6 = 20$.

sections.title: Make 10 first
facts: Adding across a ten: fill up to the ten, then add the rest. $8 + 5 = 8 + 2 + 3 = 13$.
Taking away across a ten: go back to the ten, then take the rest. $13 - 5 = 13 - 3 - 2 = 8$.

sections.title: Bonds to 100
facts: For other numbers the tens make $9$ and the ones make $10$: $37 + 63$ ($3 + 6 = 9$ tens, $7 + 3 = 10$ ones).
